svg.title: One rotated coordinate against the fixed N(0,1) codebook, before and after per-coordinate calibration. The data distribution is illustrative.
svg.desc: Here the data is shifted and stretched relative to the codebook: 18.4% of values fall past the outermost centroids (±2.152) and map to the outer centroids with quantization error. The distribution is illustrative. After a per-coordinate (shift, scale), the data matches N(0,1) and only 3.1% of values fall past the outermost centroids.

g.text: Before calibration: data drifts off the codebook grid
After (shift, scale): data aligns with the N(0,1) codebook
